description:
Portfolio Analytics Architect

Who We Are 

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role 

A Portfolio Analytics Architect is responsible for leading the data validation process end-to-end for data conversion projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of financial portfolio data, a motivation to work on data problems, strong analytical and communication skills and the ability to deliver results in adherence with project deadlines while meeting high quality standards. They take a hands-on approach to solving problems, build scalable and automated solutions, work collaboratively with project teams across regions and take ownership of the outcomes our clients depend on. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 
What You'll Do 

• Develop scalable data analytics processes for validation in Databricks 
• Write custom Python logic to detect large-scale data anomalies and automate remediation 
• Build and maintain reusable validation tools, runbooks and documentation that scale across projects 
• Prepare validation findings, discrepancy analysis and status materials that keep each data validation project on track through to completion 
• Research and identify portfolio data performance discrepancies, determine root causes and recommend how best to fix manual data issues 
• Review, compare and document system calculation methodologies differences 
• Coordinate across global project teams and time zones, communicating regular status updates for assigned data projects while effectively setting expectations 
• Mitigate project risks by effectively escalating key impediments to project leads and management 
• Prioritize and context-switch effectively to complete simultaneous projects; seeing each through to the finish line 
• Identify and implement AI-driven automation and LLM integrations to streamline implementation Who You Are 

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, Economics or a related field; CFA or FRM progress is a plus 
• 2+ years experience working in Technology, Finance, Consulting, fund accounting or investment operations 
• Hands-on experience working with complex investment datasets, including multi-asset class portfolios, performance data, and market data from various sources 
• Proficiency in Python, Spark, and/or SQL with familiarity of ETL fundamentals 
• Working knowledge of REST APIs 
• Experience with Databricks and/or a cloud-based distributed data platform 
• Solution-oriented approach and a passion for problem solving 
• Proven ability to research, design and implement solutions for complex problems 
• Positive attitude, strong work ethic, proactive and a high contributing team player 
• Independent, adaptable and can thrive in a fast-paced environment 
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document complex findings and work effectively with colleagues across time zones 
• Able to work hours that regularly overlap with teams in the US and UK 
Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 
In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

• Problem Management & RCA: Participates in root cause analysis (RCA) investigations following production incidents or release failures to identify preventative controls and improve deployment reliability.

title: Business Analysis Manager - Semantic Data
description:
Position Summary

The Knowledge Asset Manager is responsible for the ongoing stewardship, governance, quality, and maintenance of the shared knowledge and data assets that support AI-enabled sourcing and procurement capabilities.

The role ensures taxonomy definitions, classification schemas, metadata structures, standards libraries, semantic models, and evaluation datasets remain accurate, governed, and aligned to evolving business requirements. Acting as the functional custodian of the AI knowledge foundation, the Knowledge Asset Manager supports multiple AI-enabled capabilities by maintaining the information structures that enable consistent, reliable, and scalable outcomes.

Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data partners, the role ensures shared knowledge assets remain fit for purpose and continue to support both existing and future AI use cases.

The role is responsible for defining and evolving the semantic architecture that underpins AI-enabled capabilities, ensuring knowledge structures are machine-interpretable, reusable, and consistent across all solutions

Key Responsibilities
• Own and govern shared knowledge and data structures, ensuring consistent definitions, classifications, and standards across all AI-enabled capabilities
• Design and maintain ontology models, including relationships between key business concepts (e.g., supplier, service type, contract constructs, sourcing workflows)
• Define and manage taxonomy, classification schemas, metadata structures, and semantic models as the enterprise standard
• Act as gatekeeper for changes to shared knowledge structures, approving updates to taxonomy, definitions, and classifications
• Ensure semantic models are reusable across capabilities and not duplicated at the tool or implementation level
• Prevent duplication or divergence of business logic across tools or implementations
• Ensure all knowledge structures are machine-interpretable and optimized for AI consumption, not limited to business-readable formats
• Manage the lifecycle, governance, ownership, and version control of shared knowledge and data assets to ensure long-term sustainability and reuse.
• Lead data quality, governance, and standardization activities that improve the consistency, reliability, and scalability of AI-enabled capabilities.
• Support onboarding of new AI capabilities by defining and maintaining the knowledge assets, classifications, standards, and reference data required for successful deployment.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of experience in data stewardship, metadata management, knowledge management, information governance, master data management, business analysis, or related disciplines.
• Strong understanding of contractual concepts, legal provisions, and commercial terms, with the ability to define, standardize, and govern business interpretations used across AI-enabled capabilities.
• Strong understanding of how business data is structured, managed, and consumed across operational systems and digital capabilities.
• Experience supporting data quality, governance, lifecycle management, or knowledge management initiatives.
• Demonstrated ability to maintain consistency, accuracy, and governance across complex information assets used by multiple stakeholders and systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
• Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working with business, technology, and data teams.
• Experience with semantic technologies and standards (e.g., RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS, SHACL or similar frameworks)
• Experience designing or working with ontology models or structured semantic knowledge representations

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms such as Coupa, Legisway, Icertis, Ironclad, Agiloft, or similar solutions.
• Experience supporting contract intelligence, contract analytics, knowledge management, workflow automation, or AI-enabled capabilities.
